months.note: 10월에 와서 5월까지 머물고 4월에 가장 많이 지나가며, 번식지에서는 4~6월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라 전역에서 겨울을 나는 흔한 겨울새로, 침엽수림이나 오리나무 숲에서 지낸다. 주로 식물 열매와 씨앗을 먹는다. 구북구 아한대 지역에서 번식하며, 침엽수 높은 가지에 이끼와 잔가지, 털 따위로 작은 컵 모양 둥지를 짓고 알을 3~5개 낳는다. 온대와 아열대 지역에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: black chin and centre of throat

points.ko: 검은 갈색 세로무늬의 잿빛 녹색 옆구리

sexes.male: 이마와 머리꼭대기, 턱이 검고 몸은 노란빛이 강한 황록색이며, 노란 눈썹선이 있다.
sexes.female: 머리에 검은 부분이 없고 노란빛이 약하며, 흰빛 도는 아랫면에 세로줄무늬가 많다.

young: 어린새는 검은 머리와 턱이 없고, 담황갈색 위쪽과 흰 아랫면 모두에 짙은 세로줄무늬가 많아 암컷보다도 칙칙하다.

art.subject: Eurasian Siskin (Spinus spinus), adult male in winter, as seen in Korean conifer and alder woods from October to March: forehead and crown black, forming a neat cap; a small black chin patch; yellow supercilium and yellow around the olive-green ear-coverts; nape, mantle and scapulars yellow-green with fine dark streaks; rump bright yellow; throat sides and breast yellow-green; belly white; flanks greyish-green streaked blackish-brown; undertail coverts yellow at the base with white tips and faint dark marks; wings black with broad yellow wing bars and yellow bases to the flight feathers; tail black, notched, with yellow sides at the base. Slender pointed bill pale horn-brown with a darker tip; dark eye; dark brown legs.
art.pose: clinging to an alder twig, picking at seeds
art.scene: Korean winter conifer woodland and alder grove; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, winter, side view perched: black cap and small black chin, yellow supercilium, yellow-green upperparts and breast, streaked greyish-green flanks, white belly, black wings with broad yellow bars, notched black tail with yellow sides, slender brown bill and legs

adult male, winter, underside seen from below while hanging on an alder cone, head and body in line: white belly, streaked flanks, undertail coverts yellow at the base and white at the tips with faint dark marks
adult female, winter, side view perched: no black cap or chin, grey-green upperparts streaked dark, whitish underparts heavily streaked, yellow wing bars
art.build: Very small finch, 12.5cm, clearly smaller and slimmer than a sparrow; acrobatic, often hanging upside down from alder cones and conifer twigs in flocks. Bill fine, sharply pointed and conical, shorter than the head and much slimmer than most finches'. Legs short, dark brown. At rest the wingtips reach onto the tail. Tail short and deeply notched. In flight the yellow wing bars, yellow rump and yellow tail sides flash.
avoid: Do not let the black spread over the face, nape or throat; it is limited to the forehead, crown and a small chin patch.
Do not give it a thick, deep finch bill; the bill is fine and pointed.
Do not paint the female with a black cap.
Do not paint any red on the head (redpoll or goldfinch).
